subject.title: Add SQLite snapshot artifacts under backup

question: Should OpenClaw core ship `openclaw backup sqlite snapshot` now, or wait for the Scout/Lobster pilot and RFC to settle whether the long-term surface belongs in core, a host-owned plugin, or both?
rationale: The PR adds a new sensitive backup artifact contract and the PR body explicitly names the external pilot as the operational evidence checkpoint before greenlighting the core path.

options.title: Keep Draft Pending Pilot
options.body: Hold the core command after mechanical cleanup until the pilot/RFC confirms that a built-in CLI artifact is the right durable surface.

options.title: Sponsor Core Command
options.body: Accept the core command as the Phase 1 local artifact contract once lockfile and startup-policy blockers are fixed and security review is satisfied.

options.title: Move Surface To Plugin
options.body: Close or redirect the core PR if the pilot shows the host-owned plugin path is sufficient without new core CLI surface.

recommendation.title: Keep Draft Pending Pilot
recommendation.body: Hold the core command after mechanical cleanup until the pilot/RFC confirms that a built-in CLI artifact is the right durable surface.

likelyOwner.reason: galiniliev is the current assignee and already reviewed the snapshot invariant on this PR.
